# Javi Beat — Professional DJ (javibeat.com)

> Javi Beat is a Dubai-based international DJ, DJing since 1999, playing lounges, hotels, restaurants, beach clubs and rooftops. Venues include Nikki Beach Mallorca, Drift Beach Club, AURA Skypool, Attiko, Lola Taberna, Varadero Mallorca and Provocateur Dubai. He is available for private celebrations, weddings and corporate events. He teaches private 1-on-1 DJ classes in Dubai in both vinyl and digital formats.

## DJ Classes in Dubai (private, 1-on-1, in person)

Classes available now, booked by appointment. All levels, from complete beginners to advanced DJs.

- Digital DJ Course — 4500 AED — Professional DJ controller. Beatmatching with and without sync, music library and set preparation, transitions, FX and club workflow. 10 sessions of 2 hours (20 hours total).
- Vinyl Mastery Course — 5500 AED — Professional analog turntables. 100% manual beatmatching, EQ and frequency control, crate digging and analog performance craft. 10 sessions of 2 hours (20 hours total).
- Pro Pack (Vinyl + Digital) — 8500 AED — Both full courses: 20 sessions (40 hours). Saves 1500 AED versus booking both separately and includes a free pair of professional DJ headphones, delivered at the first class once payment is complete.

Booking: bookings@javibeat.com · WhatsApp: +971 58 532 4519
